A fair question

Will it sound like a bot?

Only if you want it to. Heyy learns your brand's tone, your FAQs, and how your team actually talks to customers — so replies sound like you, not a script. Buttoned-up or casual, short and punchy or warm and detailed: you set the voice, Heyy keeps it consistent on every single chat.

Trained on your brand voiceNot a generic script
Learns from real conversationsGets sharper the more it handles
You approve the tone before go-liveNothing ships without a review
